changelog:
- Initial release of the DuckDuckGo web search skill using the ddgs Python library.
- Search the web without an API key; simple command-line interface provided.
- Returns results with title, URL, and snippet; allows result count customization (default 5, max 20).
- Guidance provided for safe handling of search data and strict security guardrails against prompt injection, SSRF, and data exfiltration.
- Supports follow-up content retrieval using web_fetch on safe, publicly routable URLs only.
